🎥🩸: Simon Says (2026)

A fun-filled 21st birthday celebration turns into a nightmare when a mysterious host crashes the party and traps everyone in a deadly version of “Simon Says.” Every command must be obeyed without hesitation, and one wrong move means becoming the game’s next victim.

As panic spreads, lifelong friends begin turning on one another, unsure who can be trusted while the twisted entertainer raises the stakes with increasingly brutal challenges. What started as a night of laughter quickly becomes a desperate fight to stay alive.

Blending gruesome kills with dark comedy and nonstop suspense, Simon Says delivers a blood-soaked survival game where following the rules may be your only chance of making it out alive.

Simon Says is out now on Tubi.
